hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Non-Decreasing Bounds
hints.text: Find the longest sorted prefix arr[0..left] and the longest sorted suffix arr[right..n-1].

hints.title: Trivial Removals
hints.text: You can remove everything after left (cost n - 1 - left) or everything before right (cost right).

hints.title: Two Pointers Bridging
hints.text: Use two pointers i in 0..left and j in right..n-1. While arr[i] <= arr[j], update minimum removed length j - i - 1 and advance i.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^2) subarray removals takes O(N^3) or O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix/suffix scans followed by two-pointer bridging runs in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies that the remaining elements must consist of a prefix and a suffix merged monotonically.
